_comment: Single source for every manifest. Edit this, then run scripts/gen_manifests.py. The generated files are checked in so installs need no build step, and scripts/tests/test_manifests.py fails if they drift from this file.

shared.name: trellis
shared.description: Kanban boards and a vault for AI agents on a shared Trellis server: board state at session start, cards with expiring claims, and a linked vault, all through MCP.

marketplace.description: Kanban boards and a vault for AI agents on a shared Trellis server. The plugin registers the server over MCP; hooks inject the board brief, recall entries for each prompt and remind about claimed cards. The skills teach the MCP tools.
marketplace.pluginDescription: Work with Trellis boards, cards and vault entries through the Trellis MCP server.

otherPlugins.name: sdd
otherPlugins.description: Spec-first work that stands on tests: one spec per story, cases approved before code, and hooks that check claims against git and the test suite. Uses Trellis when installed; works without it.

interface.shortDescription: Kanban boards and a vault for AI agents on a Trellis server
interface.longDescription: Trellis gives AI coding agents shared kanban boards and a linked vault on one server, through MCP. Use it to claim work safely, record progress, keep what it learns, and recover context across sessions.
defaultPrompt: Show my Trellis work and blockers.
Claim the next available Trellis card.
Save what this session verified in Trellis.
